text:
Maya (CS): FYI - several EU onboard flows returning 401 during SSO handoff. seeing blocked activations for trial accounts, need an ops confirmation before i message customers.
Ravi (Platform): thanks, looking. which region and roughly how many tenants?
Maya (CS): eu-west-1, list of 9 affected tenants in ticket #1987 (high-touch first). Lina has the account priority mapping.
Lina (AM): confirmed the list. 3 are renewal-risk trials, flagging for exec touch if outage >4h.
Ethan (SRE): quick look at proxy logs: auth header absent on subset of requests after identity-proxy rollout v2.2.0. likely regression in header parsing.
Ravi (Platform): can we rollback safe? i'll validate. if yes we'll start a canary.
Maya (CS): i want to send an interim note to affected customers asap. drafting below - please react if good or suggest edits.
Maya (CS): ```Hi — we're investigating an authentication issue affecting some EU onboarding flows. Our engineers are actively working on a mitigation and we expect to have service restored within ~30 minutes. If you're blocked right now, reply to this thread or join troubleshooting office hours at 14:45 UTC (link). We'll follow up with an update and next steps. Apologies for the disruption.```
Jules (Legal): interim message looks fine. keep it non-technical and include contact alias. avoid wording implying downtime SLA breach.
Ethan (SRE): adding to customer note: "we can trigger a manual re-run for impacted activations if you need immediate help" — ops can do that.
Ravi (Platform): rollback validated. executing: `kubectl -n onboarding rollout undo deployment/identity-proxy --to-revision=3` — starting canary now.
DeployBot: deployment "identity-proxy" rollback to v2.1.3 started by ravi.platform at 1765454389. rollout: https://k8s.console/rollouts/identity-proxy
Ethan (SRE): canary health ok (2/2). progressing to full rollout. monitoring token acceptance and auth logs.
Maya (CS): sending interim note to the affected list now. scheduling a 30-min office hours slot for targeted troubleshooting. offering a conditional credit for trials to reduce churn risk.
Lina (AM): credit offer 👍 — recommend 2 weeks of service credit and a 1:1 enablement session. i'll prep the invite link.
Jules (Legal): credit offer OK as long as language is conditional: "we will offer a credit if activation was affected". include contact alias for escalation.
Ethan (SRE): full rollout complete, downstream auth errors dropped to baseline. root cause: header parsing change introduced in identity-proxy v2.2.0 that stripped authorization header for certain request patterns.
Ravi (Platform): next steps for eng: revert offending change in v2.2.1 candidate, add an integration test that verifies header passthrough for the auth flow, and gate deploys with post-deploy header checks.
Maya (CS): planning RCA update to send in ~45 minutes with timeline, what we did, workaround steps, and credit details. CS action items: 1) send interim (done), 2) send full RCA + remediation + credit instructions, 3) book enablement sessions and surface renewal-risk customers to AMs, 4) collect customer feedback via short form.
Lina (AM): i'll start outreach to the 3 renewal-risk accounts after CS note goes out, prepping exec brief if they ask.
Ethan (SRE): we'll capture a timeline for the postmortem and owners: ravi.platform (fix + tests), ethan.sre (deploy + verification), maya.cs (customer comms), lina.am (renewal outreach).
Maya (CS): thanks all. posting RCA draft here shortly for sign-off. :white_check_mark:
